name: IREFOX Profound 400
why_interesting: An exact historical T700-carbon all-road build with Shimano 105 R7000 2×11 and reviewed 40C tires at a low launch price.

facts.drivetrain: 2023 review sample: Shimano 105 R7000 mechanical 2×11 with 50/34T crank and a reported SunRace 34T cassette cog; cassette small cog and full range are unstated
facts.brakes: Cable-actuated hydraulic disc brakes with 160 mm rotors
facts.frame_material: T700 carbon (official exact-model catalog); fiber supplier, lay-up and molding process are not disclosed
facts.stiffness_evidence: Exact-model ride review describes relaxed, stable handling and a comfortable ride; no measured stiffness or deflection result was published
facts.tire_clearance_basis: The reviewed bike was fitted with Schwalbe 700×40C tires and the reviewer described 40C as the observed maximum; this is not a manufacturer maximum-clearance specification
facts.complete_weight_status: No exact complete-bike weight, size or weighing protocol found after 50 registered source areas

official_price.conditions: Historical list price; launch promotion was ¥6,299 and a conditional share/review rebate reduced the effective amount to ¥5,999. No current checkout or stock is established.

missing: Exact complete-bike weight and measurement basis
Cassette small cog and full range for the 2023 reviewed build
Manufacturer maximum tire clearance distinct from the reviewed 40C fitted/observed limit
Current stock, checkout price, purchase route and warranty entity
Published lay-up or molding details and measured stiffness evidence
price_status: The current indexed IREFOX China catalog still names Profound 400 but shows no price or purchase route; the only surfaced price remains the 2023 launch reference. No current exact-model mainland listing or checkout was found.
source_note: The archived official catalog and 2023 review document the exact model. The review's 34T cassette cog does not establish the cassette's small cog or full range; this build is not generalized to all seller options. No current commercial offer or complete-bike weight was found, and historical 2023 prices are not promoted as current.
